audience: service businesses and teams who take appointments with YouCanBook.me

useCases.title: Find bookings by booking page, period or text
useCases.text: The AI lists bookings filtered by booking page, a time window, cancelled status or a search text, and reads one booking by id.

useCases.title: Check the setup of a booking page
useCases.text: The AI lists your booking pages and reads the appointment types, team members and locations of one page. You see what customers can book.

useCases.title: Create a booking on a booking page
useCases.text: The AI creates a booking with start and end time, and optionally a title, time zone and locale.

useCases.title: Update, reschedule, cancel or reactivate a booking
useCases.text: The AI changes the time or title of a booking, marks it as cancelled or no-show, or cancels it. A cancelled booking can be re-activated.

useCases.title: Add or change an appointment type
useCases.text: The AI adds an appointment type to a booking page, or changes the name, description, slot length or price of an existing one.

useCases.title: Add team members and locations, or update a team member
useCases.text: The AI adds a team member linked to a calendar, updates a team member, and adds a location to a booking page.
